title: Portia Page Record
description: Version-1 durable Portia processing record for one physical page dispatched from a retained source through one immutable Core PDS2 route registration. The Page Record bridges Core routing/retention to later Portia interpretation and review while remaining non-domain evidence-processing state rather than a canonical behavior-domain fact.
$comment: Application validation remains responsible for verifying the referenced Core RouteRegistration, confirming that its target is the named Page Target in the same class/work, resolving the retained source, enforcing deterministic reuse/idempotency for the tuple (route_id, source_scan_id, source_page_number), preserving source_sha256 agreement with Core retention metadata, legal processing-state transitions, retry/reprocessing history, authorization, and ensuring that no processing state automatically materializes a behavior-domain record. Paper Interpretation generations are stored as separate immutable staging records that exact-link this Page Record; mutable latest-generation pointers and proposal/review state are not embedded here.

x-portia-application-invariants.description: The Capture Batch and Page Target must exist and agree exactly with the Page Record class_id/work_id/page_target_id.
The immutable Core RouteRegistration identified by route_id must resolve to this exact Portia Page Target in the same module/class/work context.
source_scan_id, source_sha256, and source_page_number must resolve to and agree with Core retained-source metadata; Portia must not rewrite Core source identity or route history.
Reprocessing the same route_id/source_scan_id/source_page_number must reuse the same logical Page Record processing lineage rather than create duplicate accepted interpretations or canonical records.
A different retained source returned through the same route remains a distinct physical-source intake and must not silently replace an earlier Page Record.
Matching content hashes may support duplicate review but must not automatically collapse or delete distinct Core retained-source histories.
Interpretation must use the exact historical Page Target template/layout/capture specification; a later installed template version must not silently reinterpret this Page Record.
No Page Record processing state may itself create, activate, complete, or otherwise assert a behavior-domain record or human judgment.

route_id.description: Identifier of the immutable Core PDS2 RouteRegistration used to dispatch this physical page. The Core registration remains authoritative for route content and signature semantics.

processing_state.description: Operational page-processing state only. Interpretation, proposal, human-review, and canonical materialization lifecycles are separate Issue #20 contracts and must not be inferred from this value.

failure_detail.description: Human-readable operational failure detail. Required exactly when processing_state is failed. It must not be treated as a behavior-domain assertion.

source_scan_id.description: Core retained-source identity for the immutable whole submitted source.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the immutable whole retained source, copied from and checked against Core retention metadata.

source_page_number.description: Positive one-based physical page number dispatched by Core from the retained source.
